proof_body:
by
  intro r k
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)) * (r : ℝ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)) ((r : ℝ) ^ k) := by
    rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' k]
    have h0 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)) * (r : ℝ) ^ i / (i.factorial : ℝ) * (i.descFactorial k : ℝ) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by
        rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)]; simp
    rw [h0, sub_zero]
    have := (ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_one_poissonMeasure r).mul_left ((r : ℝ) ^ k)
    rw [mul_one] at this
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) this
    have hf : ((n + k).factorial : ℝ) = (n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n + k).descFactorial k : ℝ) := by
      have := Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial (Nat.le_add_left k n)
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
      exact_mod_cast this.symm
    have hn : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hd : ((n + k).descFactorial k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      have : ((n + k).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at hf; exact this hf
    rw [hf, pow_add]
    field_simp
  have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrable_poissonMeasure_iff]
    simpa only [Real.norm_natCast] using h1.summable
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  have h2 := ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_integral_poissonMeasure hint
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h2
  exact h2.unique h1
target_source: ∀ (r : NNReal) (k : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) ∧ ∫ n : ℕ, (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) ∂(ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) = (r : ℝ) ^ k
